desc: Betty Crocker Rich & Creamy Vanilla Frosting is a sweet, smooth, and spreadable topping designed to enhance your baked treats. Whether you’re decorating a layered cake or icing a batch of cupcakes, this frosting spreads easily and stays in place. Its creamy vanilla flavor complements everything from chocolate cake to sugar cookies. It’s also gluten-free and ready to use straight from the tub—no prep or mess required.
features:
Features:

Smooth and Creamy Texture

This frosting has a thick, velvety texture that spreads easily on cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and more.

Classic Vanilla Flavor

Delivers a rich vanilla taste that pairs perfectly with a wide range of desserts.

Ready-to-Use Convenience

Comes fully prepared in a 16-ounce tub. Just open, stir if needed, and apply—no mixing or additional ingredients required

Gluten-Free Certified

Suitable for individuals with gluten intolerance or those following a gluten-free diet.

Shelf-Stable

Does not require refrigeration until after opening, making it easy to store in your pantry.

Covers a Full Cake

One tub is enough to frost a 13x9 inch cake, two 8-inch or 9-inch round cake layers, or up to 24 cupcakes.

Benefits:

Saves Time

Perfect for quick decorating or last-minute baking needs without sacrificing flavor or texture.

Great for All Skill Levels

Ideal for beginner bakers, busy parents, and professionals looking for a reliable shortcut.

Kid-Approved Taste

Sweet, smooth, and classic—always a hit at birthday parties, school events, and celebrations.

Trusted Brand Quality

From the Betty Crocker line, known for decades of consistency and delicious baking products.

Customizable

Can be tinted with food coloring or flavored with extracts for unique dessert creations.
ingredients: Sugar, water, palm oil, cocoa processed with alkali, corn starch, corn syrup. contains 2% or less of: salt, monoglycerides, polysorbate 60, citric acid, sodium stearoyl lactylate, sodium acid pyrophosphate, artificial flavor. freshness preserved by potassium sorbate.
